close_reason: Acknowledged. The catch-all on BackendSetError (5 sites in filenode.rs) is the workspace pattern for upstream-#[non_exhaustive] enums and must not be 'simplified' to a closed match. The orthogonal P2 (.15) about a more useful catch-all message stands.
description:
Per workspace AGENTS.md, BackendSetError is #[non_exhaustive]. Every match against it in src/filenode.rs has the explicit Err(_) catch-all (5 occurrences). This is the right pattern even though it produces visually noisy code: future BackendSetError variants will compile against this crate without breaking changes, AND the runtime behavior is defined ('unhandled backend error variant' serverFail) rather than UB or accidental match.

A future contributor will be tempted to 'simplify' the match by removing the catch-all (clippy might suggest matches!(...) shapes). Defend this: the catch-all is the contract with the upstream BackendSetError. Without it, adding a variant upstream becomes a breaking change for every downstream handler. See JMAP-510h.15 for the orthogonal improvement (make the catch-all message more useful).
title: Good: BackendSetError marked #[non_exhaustive] AND every match has explicit Err(_) catch-all
